skill.name: document-writing-coordination
skill.description: Coordinate large documentation projects by planning an outline, delegating sections to doc writer agents, tracking VibeKanban tasks, and reviewing sections for consistency.
skill.summary: Plan, delegate, monitor, and review multi-agent documentation work through VibeKanban.
skill.author: ClementWalter

security_audit.summary: All 78 static findings were reviewed and adjudicated as false positives. The backtick findings are Markdown examples, inline paths, VibeKanban MCP tool names, or a hardcoded read-only git reference, not executable shell or Ruby code. The reconnaissance flags refer to checklist wording or VibeKanban coordination context, and no prompt injection or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: Markdown examples trigger command execution pattern matching.
remediation.suggestion: Label examples as non-executable templates and avoid unnecessary command-like formatting where plain text is enough.

remediation.issue: One template mentions a git log command for document context.
remediation.suggestion: State that local commands should only be run with user approval, or replace it with a request for recent change history.

remediation.issue: Examples include absolute paths and UUID-like identifiers.
remediation.suggestion: Use neutral placeholders for paths, project identifiers, and task identifiers in published examples.

content.value_statement: Large technical documents are hard to plan, delegate, and review across many sections. This skill provides a VibeKanban workflow for outlines, section tasks, progress tracking, and consistency reviews.
actual_capabilities: Creates document outlines with section scopes, table of contents, and pending placeholders.
Builds section task descriptions with context, source files, outputs, and acceptance criteria.
Coordinates VibeKanban task creation, status updates, workspace sessions, and task reviews.
Provides templates for standard, technical, overview, utility, and security sections.
Defines review checklists for accuracy, completeness, style, links, and cross-references.
Supports fallback delegation through a general task agent when repositories are not configured.
limitations: Requires VibeKanban MCP tools for automated task tracking and workspace sessions.
Coordinates writing work rather than writing every final section directly.
Depends on accurate project context, source files, and document goals from the user.
Does not independently verify external links beyond available agent capabilities.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a Design Document
use_cases.description: Split a large architecture document into scoped sections and assign each section to a doc writer agent.

use_cases.title: Manage Documentation Reviews
use_cases.description: Track section status, review completed work, reject incomplete sections, and maintain consistency across the document.

use_cases.title: Scale Deep Technical Coverage
use_cases.description: Create focused tasks for complex components, security sections, utilities, and overview material.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Document Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an outline for a technical design document about [project]. Include sections, scope notes, and pending placeholders.

prompt_templates.title: Delegate Sections
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn an outline into VibeKanban tasks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create VibeKanban task descriptions for each pending section in [document path]. Include context, source files, outputs, and acceptance criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Monitor and Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the current VibeKanban tasks for [project]. Report status by section, review completed sections, and identify next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Complex Document
prompt_templates.scenario: Run a full multi-agent documentation workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Coordinate a full design document for [repository]. Explore the codebase, create an outline, delegate sections, monitor tasks, and run consistency reviews.

output_examples.input: Create an architecture design document outline for a new repository.
output_examples.output: A structured outline with a table of contents, scoped section notes, and pending placeholders for each writer task.

output_examples.input: Delegate the core component sections to doc writer agents.
output_examples.output: A set of section task descriptions with context, required skills, source files, output instructions, and review criteria.

output_examples.input: Review all completed documentation tasks for consistency.
output_examples.output: A review summary covering accuracy, missing content, terminology consistency, cross-references, and required follow-up tasks.

best_practices: Provide the repository, document goal, target audience, and preferred depth before creating tasks.
Keep each section task scoped enough for one writer to complete and review independently.
Run a consistency review after each accepted section and again before final delivery.
anti_patterns: Asking the coordinator to write all sections instead of delegating work to document writers.
Creating vague section tasks without source files, boundaries, or acceptance criteria.
Starting VibeKanban workspace sessions before project and repository identifiers are configured.

faq.question: Does this skill write the full document itself?
faq.answer: No. It coordinates outlines, task delegation, monitoring, and review while doc writer agents draft sections.

faq.question: What tools does it expect?
faq.answer: It is designed for VibeKanban MCP tools and can fall back to a general task agent when needed.

faq.question: Can it handle design documents?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples include architecture, component, testing, security, and roadmap sections.

faq.question: How does it keep sections consistent?
faq.answer: It uses review checklists for terminology, cross-references, structure, duplicate content, and formatting.

faq.question: Can writers create subtasks?
faq.answer: Yes. The templates include delegation rules for splitting large sections into smaller VibeKanban tasks.

faq.question: Is repository access required?
faq.answer: Repository access improves source accuracy. VibeKanban workspace sessions also need configured repository identifiers.
